newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Morgan trust weightings changed May/June - document.
newsitem.headline: Morgan trust weightings changed May/June - document.

text.p: A list of stocks held by Morgan Grenfell's European Growth Trust at June 27 shows slight changes in the weighting of the top 10 companies.
A document made available to Reuters shows British Biotech as representing 7.73 percent of the fund, compared to 6.91 percent at end-May.

The fund was one of three Morgan Grenfell Asset Management European funds temporarily suspended this week pending an investigation into possible irregularities, which is being undertaken by British investments watchdog IMRO.
Following is the list of top 10 companies, representing 39 percent of the fund's portfolio, at June 27, with end-May figures in brackets.

British Biotech (UK) 7.73 percent (6.91); Nokia (Finland) 5.05 (5.84), ASM Lithography (Netherlands) 4.71 (5.12); Oralmed (Germany) 4.22 (3.68); Nera 3.47 (unchanged); SGS -Thomson Micro (France) 3.41 (3.89); Medtech (Germany) 3.36 (4.12); TTTieto (Finland) 2.51 (2.21); Pricer (Sweden) 2.50 (1.83), Alulux Mining (Germany) 2.04 (2.42).
Oralmed, Medtech and Alulux are all unlisted.

Sweden 16 pct (17); Britain 14 (10.5); Germany 13 (14.5); Norway 10 (14.3); Finland 12 (13); Switzerland 6.0 (4.0); Netherlands 5.0 (5.1); France 5.0 (4.0), Austria 3.0 (unavailable), Cash 10 percent, others 6.0 (13.2).
